close_reason: OpenSSL cannot directly oracle codesign (no -purpose codesign verb); superseded by pyca-composition approach in new bead under PKIX-fmtv parent. See notes for full decision rationale.
description:
Wrapper-level differential test for pkix_chain::verify_code_signer against 'openssl verify -purpose codesign'.

Source corpus: pkix-chain/tests/fixtures/leaf-codesigning.der. No subject binding (code-signing wrapper doesn't bind hostname/mailbox); the diff is on EKU enforcement and chain validity only.

Acceptance:
- pkix-difftest/tests/verify_wrapper_openssl_codesign.rs covers the codesigning fixtures.
- baseline-verify-openssl.md gets a code-signing section.

Blocks on PKIX-fmtv.18.1.
notes:
[2026-05-13 decision: superseded, not an OpenSSL diff]

OpenSSL CLI's purpose list ('sslclient, sslserver, nssslserver, smimesign, smimeencrypt, crlsign, any, ocsphelper, timestampsign') has no 'codesign' verb. Confirmed by bd-spin 2026-05-13.

Rejected resolutions:
- Chain-only diff with -purpose any: would say 'agree' even when verify_code_signer has purpose-specific bugs (false confidence on the wrapper's core job)
- Custom -verify_name policy: OpenSSL has no codesign policy name
- Third-party signing-binary oracle (osslsigncode/signtool): wrong tool category, signs binaries, not cert chains
- Accept gap, close: leaves a coverage hole on the wrapper's purpose-specific behavior

Adopted resolution: **compose pyca chain primitives + standalone hand-rolled id-kp-codeSigning EKU check** as an independent oracle. Pyca's PolicyBuilder is TLS-bound, but Certificate.verify_directly_issued_by() + extensions.get_extension_for_class(ExtendedKeyUsage) cover chain walk + EKU check. The hand-rolled EKU check lives in pkix-difftest/oracles/, not in workspace code under test — this is independent cross-validation per AGENTS.md test discipline, not workspace-code-as-own-oracle.

The chosen approach is **not an OpenSSL diff**, which is what this bead's title/scope said. Closing as superseded; new bead filed for the actual work (see below).

Closing reason: scope changed from 'OpenSSL -purpose codesign diff' to 'pyca composition diff'; new bead filed under PKIX-fmtv as a sibling of .18 and .19.
title: OpenSSL diff: verify_code_signer vs -purpose codesign
